a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate to 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up short, so please don't also take 4. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for you and won't take anything more. If you'd strongly prefer a different split, tell me and I'll weigh it next round.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
